label: prop:q-hecke-eigenvalue
title: $q$-Hecke eigenvalues from the fibre functor
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with substrate parameter q. Let \mathcal{M} be a q-Hecke eigensheaf on \mathrm{Bun}_{G_q}(X) (q-Hecke eigensheaf). Its eigenvalue \mathcal{L}_q \in \mathrm{LocSys}_{\check{G}_q}(X) is uniquely determined by the action of \tau on the Hecke eigenvalue data:

  \mathcal{L}_q \simeq
  \mathrm{Aut}^\otimes(\tau)\text{-}\mathrm{equivariantisation of }
  \big\{ V_\lambda^{(q)}(\mathcal{L}_q)_x \big\}_{\lambda, x}.

The rigidity of the fibre functor (fibre-functor rigidity) implies that this collection of Hecke eigenvalues determines \mathcal{L}_q up to unique isomorphism.
heading: Proposition
